notes: The italic the* angel* is marked added under rule 17; the ASV italics corroborate but do not decide it (rule 7).
the angel is one added unit, its determiner and noun standing together and doing one office (rule 2), headed on angel.

מַפְלִא takes the adverb wondrously and the infinitive לַעֲשׂוֹת the finite did, as rule 56 divides an auxiliary verb whose whole contribution the ASV writes as an adverb; the לְ keeps nothing (rules 52 and 40).
